title: What Is AIVideosUGC? Company Facts for Sellers | AIVideosUGC
description: What AIVideosUGC makes from a product photo or a product page link: store images, short ads, actors, voice, captions, and an editor. Plans from $24.50 a month.
lead: AIVideosUGC turns one product photo or a product page link into store images and short video ads. Here is what it does, what it costs, and what you can add before you publish.
summary: It makes store images and short videos from a product photo or a product page link, and can add an actor, a script, voice, and captions.

describe: AIVideosUGC is an online tool that turns a product photo, or a public product page link, into store images and short videos. You choose the frame and the length, add an actor, a script, a spoken line, captions, and music if you want them, and edit those in the tool. You see the credit cost, then download a file with no watermark or send it to TikTok, Instagram, or Facebook.

faq.a: An online tool for stores. Upload a product photo, or paste a product page link, and download a store image or a short video you can edit and publish.

Monthly plans start at $24.50 with 200 credits. Pro is $35 with 300 credits, and Premium is $63 with 600. Each video or photo shows its credit cost before it starts, and a failed job returns those credits. There is no free plan.

faq.q: Does an AIVideosUGC video include a spoken line?
faq.a: Yes. A short ad can include a spoken line, captions you can edit, and music from the library. A spokesperson clip uses an actor who says the line you write. See [AI spokesperson video](page:spokesperson-videos).

faq.q: What video settings can I choose?
faq.a: Choose 6, 10, 15, or 30 seconds, and 9:16, 1:1, 16:9, 4:3, or 3:4. The same product photo can become a vertical ad, a square clip, or a wide frame.

faq.q: How many credits does a video or photo use?
faq.a: A photo uses 24 credits. Videos use 24 for 6 seconds, 40 for 10 seconds, 60 for 15 seconds, and 120 for 30 seconds. The exact cost is on screen before the job starts.

faq.q: Can I use the results in ads and on my store?
faq.a: Yes. Downloaded photos and videos can be used commercially and have no watermark. You can post them on marketplaces, social platforms, and your own store, under each platform's rules.
Yes. Choose an actor from the library, or build a presenter from photos you have the rights to, and use that presenter again on the next video.

faq.q: Can other software send a job?
faq.a: Yes. The API lets your own software send a job. Email support@aivideosugc.com if you need access.

faq.q: Can I make more than one version at a time?
faq.a: Yes. Make a batch of versions from one product photo. Each version shows its credit cost before it starts.
